# #435 — DREAM-11: REM moves to a hosted model — the local-capacity constraints are measured dead

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: enhancement
Created: 2026-07-28T19:01:22Z
Updated: 2026-08-04T23:27:31Z

---

Local plan with full reasoning: `_plans/draft-dream-hosted-rem.md`

## Why

`docs/dream-design.md` sizes REM around a 4B model resident on core01 competing with Postgres for ~3 GB of unified memory. Two measurements on 2026-07-28 remove that constraint.

**1. The entire candidate corpus is one prompt.** 835,211 chars (~209k tokens) for all 1,414 candidates. The 310 exchanges alone — the population that matters — are 586,251 chars (~147k tokens), which fits in a single call on every model tested.

**2. The local 4B was never fairly measured.** `dream-design.md:809` cites it "mislabelling 112 of 214 candidates as `preference`" as the reason confidence must be corroborated. That run had `enable_thinking` left on; Qwen3.5-4B is a reasoning model, so the parser was reading deliberation instead of the verdict. The cited evidence does not support the conclusion drawn from it.

## Measured dead

| Design element | Cite | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Memory headroom as a required trigger | `:311`, `:1129` | Exists because a local model competes with Postgres. Nothing loads locally. |
| Bounded forced slice / thundering herd | `:328-336` | The herd is against core01. Six hours of backlog is a fraction of one prompt. |
| "Under load, choosier not busier" | `:337-339` | Defers work that would steal from serving. Nothing to steal. |
| Low high-water mark as the real fix | `:330-333` | Workaround for not being able to eat a big bite. |
| ~3 GB core01 budget for REM | `:761`, `:1086` | Spoken for by nothing. |
| REM model column "local (small)" | `:84` | Wrong. |

## Survives

- Yield on request (`:341-346`)
- **REM prepares, Deep commits** (`:127`) — a permissions boundary, not a capability one
- Confidence must be measured, not claimed (`:806-816`)
- The reversibility axis (`:96-119`), R3 precedence as a hard stop (`:790-792`)

## Also in scope

REM's output type changes: from emitting a *grade* to emitting *drafted work* — merged claims, paired contradictions, grouped bundles with proposed resolutions. Deep verifies and commits. This moves the 90/10 line (`:274-278`) toward REM while preserving `:127`.

## Model selection (measured)

Round-two bake-off, 30 nodes, 6 prompts x 5 model/effort configs, same 50 items, schema-validated. **Terra low == Terra med** (11 distinct score values each, means 5.0 vs 5.2) — extra thinking budget bought nothing. **Terra low is the REM model.**

## Acceptance

- [ ] `dream-design.md` records which constraints are measured dead, with the numbers
- [ ] REM trigger has no memory-headroom gate and no bounded-slice logic
- [ ] REM runs on terra low
- [ ] REM still yields within one job of a request arriving
- [ ] REM writes `machine_grade` and never `review_action`
